title: 第24章 时空次元神庙第25章 次元神与时空神
content_zh:
“顾丫头，有没有相中九天神国的某个青年才俊啊？
我可听说追你的人不少啊，也不小了，是该找个男朋友了啊哈哈哈。”陈纵横说道。
“这妮子眼界高着呢，不知道会看上谁呢。”顾辞笑道。
“哎呀，还早呢。”顾千言羞红了脸，偷偷瞟了一眼正在干饭的邪帝，心中依然一顿失落。你连话都没跟我说一句，甚至连看都没看我一眼。
“邪帝，吃完了没？”神君放下筷子望向邪帝。
“走吧。”邪帝吐出一块骨头。
“我跟神君去处理点事。”邪帝向冰帝说道。
“注意安全。”圣君眼巴巴的看着神君。
“等我回来。”圣君点了点头。
纳米战衣覆盖在神君身上，极光、魅影化为灵魂体进入神君、邪帝心中。
二人跟长辈们打了声招呼便离开了。
“老大，你说他们干嘛去了？”圣君还是好奇。
“没告诉我们应该是蛮危险的事吧。”冰帝看上去并不担心。
......
“什么事啊？”神君与邪帝飞在空中。
“这是超神丹的丹方，上面的药材我回来那天就让索罗森去找了，到现在一味还没找到。”邪帝拿出一张纸。
“超神殿那搜刮来的？”神君接过丹方，“这些药材确实难找啊。你去血腥之森找过了？”
“我没去找，我直接去找了圣天王龙，让它帮忙，它答应了，它还告诉了我件事情。”
“所以是要处理这件事是吧？”
“对的。”说着，邪帝又拿出一张纸，“这是血腥之森的地图，上面是圣天王龙座下四圣兽标记的地方，这些地方出现了不同的时空裂缝与次元黑洞。”

“什么？时空裂缝？次元黑洞？有什么东西跑出来了嘛？”
“没有，圣天王龙有派人盯着。我们去探查一番。”
“这样。”
......
半小时后，神君邪帝二人来到血腥之森的最深处。
在他们面前，一座巨大的宫殿，邪帝推门而入。
一只巨龙坐在主位上，人形巨龙，撑着龙头，看着邪帝神君。
圣天王龙！龙人族！血腥之森的守护者！
“来啦，邪帝神君。”
“你怎么没精打采的？”邪帝看着圣天王龙。
“我想出去玩啊，好烦啊，多怪你。”邪帝满头黑线。
六年前，邪帝误入这里，把上一任血腥之森的守护者光明飞龙打的自闭，让还在修炼的圣天王龙提早上任536年。
“王龙大人，那我这就带邪帝大人和神君大人去时空裂缝和次元黑洞了？”走过来一个蛇人，圣天王龙座下四圣兽之一蛇王。
“哈欠～去吧去吧，出了什么问题立马汇报。”
......
十分钟后，蛇王带着邪帝和神君来到时空裂缝和次元黑洞处，这处地方比较神奇，其他地方要么只有时空裂缝要么只有次元黑洞，这里俩个都有。
“好强的时空次元属性。我总感觉有声音从里面传出来。”神君感受着眼前的时空裂缝和次元黑洞。
“我也觉得有声音。”邪帝点了点头。
蛇王看着这俩人，“有声音嘛，我怎么没听到？”
“你没有嘛？”邪帝看着蛇王，“我感觉它在说......在......说进来。”“进......进......进来？”

“我也是。”邪帝神君俩人对视了一眼。
“蛇王，我俩进去了。”邪帝淡淡的说道。
“这，两位大人，你们有点冒险吧？”
“不用管我们，你回去跟圣天王龙讲一声就行了。”神君挥了挥手。
content_en:
“Girl Gu, have you fallen in love with a young talent from the Nine Heavens Divine Kingdom?
I heard that there are a lot of people chasing you, and you are not young anymore. It’s time to find a boyfriend, hahaha. "Chen Zongheng said.
"This girl has great vision. I wonder who she will fall in love with." Gu Ci said with a smile.
"Oh, it's still early." Gu Qianyan blushed with embarrassment and glanced at the Evil Emperor who was cooking, feeling still disappointed. You didn't even say a word to me, you didn't even look at me.
"Evil Emperor, have you finished eating?" The Lord God put down his chopsticks and looked at the Evil Emperor.
"Let's go." The Evil Emperor spat out a bone.
"The Lord God and I will go handle something." The Evil Emperor said to the Ice Emperor.
"Pay attention to safety." Shengjun looked at Shenjun eagerly.
"Wait for me to come back." Shengjun nodded.
The nano-suit covered the body of the Divine Lord, and Aurora and Phantom turned into soul bodies and entered the hearts of the Divine Lord and the Evil Emperor.
The two said hello to the elders and left.
"Boss, what do you think they did?" Shengjun was still curious.
"It must be quite dangerous for not telling us." The Ice Emperor didn't look worried.
...
"What's going on?" The Divine Lord and the Evil Emperor were flying in the air.
"This is the recipe for the Super Divine Pill. I asked Thoroson to look for the medicinal ingredients on it the day I came back, but I still haven't found them yet." The Evil Emperor took out a piece of paper.
"The one looted from the Super Temple?" Shen Jun took the pill recipe, "These medicinal materials are really hard to find. Have you gone to the Bloody Forest to look for them?"
"I didn't go looking for it. I went directly to the Holy Heavenly King Dragon and asked it to help. It agreed, and it also told me something."
"So you have to deal with this, right?"
"That's right." As he said that, the Evil Emperor took out another piece of paper, "This is a map of the Bloody Forest. On it are the places marked by the four holy beasts under the Dragon Seat of the Holy Heavenly King. Different time and space cracks and dimensional black holes appear in these places."
"What? A rift in space and time? A dimensional black hole? Did something escape?"
"No, Shengtian Wanglong has sent someone to keep an eye on it. Let's go investigate."
"This way."
...
Half an hour later, the gods and evil emperors arrived at the deepest part of the bloody forest.
In front of them, there was a huge palace, and the Evil Emperor pushed open the door and entered.
A giant dragon sat on the main seat, a human-shaped dragon, holding the dragon's head and looking at the Evil Emperor and God Lord.
Holy Heavenly King Dragon! Dragon tribe! Guardian of the Bloody Forest!
"Here we come, Evil Emperor God Lord."
"Why are you so listless?" The Evil Emperor looked at the Holy Heavenly King Dragon.
"I want to go out and play. I'm so annoyed. I blame you." The Evil Emperor's head was full of black lines.
Six years ago, the Evil Emperor mistakenly entered here and beat the previous guardian of the Bloody Forest, Guangming Feilong, into isolation, allowing the Holy Heavenly King Dragon, who was still practicing, to take office 536 years ahead of schedule.
"Lord Wang Long, then I will take Lord Evil Emperor and Lord Shenjun to the cracks in time and space and the dimensional black hole?" A snake man came over, the Snake King, one of the four holy beasts under the Dragon Seat of the Holy Heavenly King.
"Yawn~ Go ahead, go ahead, report any problems immediately."
...
Ten minutes later, the Snake King took the Evil Emperor and the Divine Lord to the space-time rift and the dimensional black hole. This place was quite magical. Other places either only had space-time rifts or dimensional black holes, but there were both here.
"Such a strong space-time dimensional attribute. I always feel like there is a voice coming from inside." Shenjun felt the space-time cracks and dimensional black holes in front of him.
"I also felt there was a sound." The Evil Emperor nodded.
The Snake King looked at the two people, "There was a sound, why didn't I hear it?"
"Don't you?" The Evil Emperor looked at the Snake King, "I feel like it's saying... coming... coming in." "Coming... coming... coming in?"
"Me too." The Evil Emperor and God Lord looked at each other.
"Snake King, we are going in." The Evil Emperor said calmly.
"Here, two adults, are you taking a bit of a risk?"
"No needLeave us alone, just go back and talk to Shengtian Wanglong. "The Lord Shen waved his hand.
